Valdés Peninsula: elephant seals on the dry Atlantic shore

In the morning, another excursion lasting about **7 hours** offers a chance to spot whales and other marine wildlife.

Toward evening, transfer to the airport (about **1 hour**) and fly to Bariloche. On arrival, transfer to the hotel (about **40 minutes**). Stay at **Villa Beluno**.

Bariloche sits on the shore of Lake Nahuel Huapi in central Patagonia. Mountains, forests, lakes and glaciers surround the city. Bariloche was granted city status in the early 20th century.

Downtown Bariloche has shopping streets, cafés and restaurants, as well as Bariloche Cathedral, built in 1946 and listed as a national historic monument.

Bariloche is often compared to Alpine resorts for its architecture, mountain scenery and local chocolate. Nahuel Huapi National Park surrounds the city. Cerro Campanario has views of the lakes and mountains. Nearby are Playa Bonita, the Llao Llao Peninsula, Lake Moreno, Huemul Island, San Eduardo Chapel and El Trébol Bay.

In winter, Bariloche is a ski resort. In summer and spring, popular activities include excursions, fishing and lake outings.
